## Market renewal, selection and capture

**ID:** `market-dynamics-math` · **Category:** mathematical model

**Source:** [MARKET-DYNAMICS-MATH.md](../chapters/MARKET-DYNAMICS-MATH.md)

**Status:** Checked conditional formal result

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `8bfdb03be8f9…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Given explicit returns, renewal, collection and intervention laws, actual liability changes relative returns, while accumulated influence changes later selection. Sufficient invariant-region conditions jointly maintain renewal, accountability and separate supports; the model also identifies recovery and collapse regions.

**Significance:** Connects what wins today with how winners change tomorrow’s rules.

**Scope:** 39 Lean results cover rational transitions, invariance and accounts; real-valued attraction limits retain historical hand-proof status. Institutional legitimacy, calibration and market correspondence are supplied.

**Next:** Ongoing: preserve the conditional model. Proposed: identify a real market and test entry, price formation, miscalibrated liability and capture.

<a id="markets-and-generative-regimes"></a>
<a id="使市场维持生成方向--keeping-markets-in-generative-regimes"></a>
## Keeping markets in generative regimes

**ID:** `markets-and-generative-regimes` · **Category:** application

**Source:** [MARKETS-AND-GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md](../chapters/MARKETS-AND-GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md)

**Status:** Conditional framework; degeneration boundaries checked

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `ce8d50a91534…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Market practices earn returns while changing conditions of future production and life. When those consequences affect selection and funded, accountable correction can persist, a renewing regime becomes conditionally possible. Profit and stability alone do not certify its quality. Enshittification is treated as a concrete institutional form of degeneration: relations and dependence formed in shared activity become control that limits later shared creation and correction.

**Significance:** Turns the generative direction into an inspectable institutional question, including people without market leverage.

**Scope:** The original framework and model are complete at local scope. From 8 October: degeneration boundary 19 theorems/27 audits (exact margin M), local attraction with actual support 38/52, supported finite transition 27/35, partial correction 26/31 and finite-support obstruction 17/22; Reddit/Apollo, D&D, ad tech, LibreOffice and Narwhal are historical correspondences without new theorems. Lean concerns the model, not the legitimacy or effectiveness of real governance; full basins and real thresholds are not given.

**Next:** Ongoing: how beneficial alternatives and corrections obtain effective influence as dependence changes, and how downstream adaptation feeds back on upstream rule selection. Proposed: identify institutional change in actual return relations and transition conditions over full state domains, actual support and rates of change.

**Lean correspondence:** [MarketGenerativity.lean](../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/MarketGenerativity.lean)

Correspondence covers only the stated premises and subclaims; source existence does not establish a fresh check of the current version.

<a id="mathematical-core"></a>
<a id="系统谓词与证明的数学核心--a-mathematical-core-for-systems-predicates-and-proofs"></a>
## A mathematical core for systems predicates and proofs

**ID:** `mathematical-core` · **Category:** mathematics

**Source:** [MATHEMATICAL-CORE.md](../chapters/MATHEMATICAL-CORE.md)

**Status:** Checked conditional formal result

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `548310e896c6…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** A small working core represents possible transformations (a configuration type, an event type and an admissible transition relation), composes them into finite histories, and supports checkable statements and proofs about configurations, histories and whole processes in Lean’s dependent type theory. Composition, finite reachability, property preservation and certain exact changes of representation have checked derivations. The core separates three tasks: constructing a representation, proving consequences within it, and establishing its correspondence to an actual process; a proof assistant verifies only the second. Configurations and events are analytical expressions of one unfolding; system boundaries, observing positions and capacities to act must be explained through particular relations, and putting everything into one tuple proves neither causal connection nor nonduality. The same interface represents formation, recurrence, destruction, failure, interruption and stable configurations.

**Significance:** It gives system reasoning an explicit, reusable mathematical language and makes the relation among representation, proof and correspondence visible; it is L0 of the Becoming spine.

**Scope:** Six modules and 61 printed axiom audits, all empty; twelve are new expository consequences, not novel mathematics. It derives neither all real laws, all mathematics nor ethical judgments from no premises; deriving an application’s law and its real correspondence remain connected explanatory work.

**Next:** State new formal results on the Becoming spine and extend it rather than build another model; universal mathematical constitution and ethical grounding keep their own premises and completion conditions.

## The frontier of mathematical reconstruction

**ID:** `mathematical-root-frontier` · **Category:** mathematics

**Source:** [MATHEMATICAL-ROOT-FRONTIER.md](../chapters/MATHEMATICAL-ROOT-FRONTIER.md)

**Status:** Checked results and open questions

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `be529efdaabb…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Supplied realizations, structure-preserving maps and admission conditions reconstruct operations, truth and theories. Finite formation covers declared finite types; dependent-family work adds pairs and sections while proving that pointwise finiteness does not itself warrant admission of the whole family.

**Significance:** Separates provable coverage and admission from constitutive priority.

**Scope:** Coverage study 36 theorems/66 audits, dependent families 33/52 and potential continuation 22/45, each scoped. Potential continuation agrees with ambient truth under stated conditions but derives no unrestricted modal entitlement or classical whole-range truth. Dependent-language truth, independently warranted infinite admission and exclusive constitution remain open.

**Next:** Ongoing: justify the modal commitments from independently warranted formation relationships while preserving the intended mathematical content; recoding the same supplied range does not suffice. Function-language transport, full higher-order admission, foundation-wide coverage and exclusive constitutive priority retain their own obligations.

<a id="mathematical-truth-and-the-root"></a>
<a id="数学真理与生成根基--mathematical-truth-and-the-generative-root"></a>
## Mathematical truth and the generative root

**ID:** `mathematical-truth-and-the-root` · **Category:** mathematics

**Source:** [MATHEMATICAL-TRUTH-AND-THE-ROOT.md](../history/MATHEMATICAL-TRUTH-AND-THE-ROOT.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Relative result; universal target open

**Argument:** Given formation, identity, existence and interpretation, a generative presentation determines a structure and its truths, including arithmetic truths beyond a fixed effective prover. Rival grounding accounts can preserve those truths; determination, isomorphism and extensional dependence do not establish exclusive constitution.

**Significance:** Provides relative constitution beyond a sociology of mathematics while separating semantic determination from metaphysical uniqueness.

**Status:** Checked results and open questions

**Argument:** Mathematical representations retain distinctions relevant to questions; acquiring and revising them requires formation, evidence and executable operations. Current studies prove first-order witness adequacy, higher-order truth transport, finite admission and named-theory coverage on declared domains. The full semantic domains still need warrant. New induction work narrows the predicate selection needed for exhaustive generation to one admitting the generated orbit, and characterizes universal recursion on a supplied carrier.

**Significance:** Connects mechanisms of mathematical learning with relative reconstruction of mathematical subjects.

**Scope:** This synthesis contains historical hand proofs, experiments and later Lean packages; it is not one assumption-free theorem of all mathematics. The induction study adds 28 theorems/47 audits while retaining ambient natural-number iteration and collective-domain commitments. A potentialist continuation adds 22 theorems/45 audits, including a fork where every value is initially reachable yet nested quantification fails.

**Next:** Ongoing: independent warrant for the full continuation range and classical generality, alongside admission of inductive domains and richer languages. Next: reduce substantive explanatory dependencies rather than add another equivalent presentation.

<a id="measured-feedback-correspondence"></a>
<a id="测得的反馈与实际对应--measured-feedback-and-physical-correspondence"></a>
## Measured feedback and physical correspondence

**ID:** `measured-feedback-correspondence` · **Category:** empirical identification

**Source:** [MEASURED-FEEDBACK-CORRESPONDENCE.md](../history/MEASURED-FEEDBACK-CORRESPONDENCE.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Scoped empirical and formal result; independently reviewed

**Argument:** In three published temperature-controller runs (1,797 samples), all 1,794 subsequent commands are reconstructed from actual readings, time differences and the stated PI controller; an exact-rational check agrees within 7.43×10⁻¹⁴ percentage points, so readings, retained feedback and issued action are connected item by item. Lean derives a command-error bound from reading difference, integral-memory difference, gains and elapsed time, feeding the existing action-sensitive scale theorem. Continuations derive later integral-memory error through the actual recurrence from its initial value; reconstruct the source’s actual candidate generation, where correcting signed versus absolute movement leaves the winning gains unchanged but reverses 8,454 of 32,640 pairwise rankings; prove residual-transfer nonidentification; and form a timing domain from execution order, throughout which the ARX run has higher requested-command exposure than both nonlinear runs. Better tracking can come with more command movement, and a past maximum residual is not a future guarantee.

**Significance:** Composition, explanation of supplied premises and real-world correspondence are achieved together in one scoped inference, with real losses and counterexamples retained.

**Scope:** Secondary analysis of archived physical observations, not a new experiment. Lean rounds: 13 theorems/26 audits (closure 147); 13/21 (168); 10/14 (228); 8/9 (237). Independent reviews rebuilt every audit and number. Percent-seconds is an exposure proxy, not electrical energy; engineering weights and setpoints supply neither G0, basic living claims nor legitimate authority.

**Next:** Justified measurement/model domains and actual timed feasibility → warranted common response; future latency, true-temperature calibration and drift, and the consequences of issuing an alternative earlier still need evidence.

<a id="new-possibilities"></a>
<a id="新可能性的形成--formation-of-new-possibilities"></a>
## Formation of new possibilities

**ID:** `new-possibilities` · **Category:** mechanism

**Source:** [NEW-POSSIBILITIES.md](../history/NEW-POSSIBILITIES.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Checked conditional formal result

**Argument:** New capabilities can arise from newly formed organization among existing activities: new connections enable effects previously unavailable, and some of those effects change how further organization forms. One must distinguish whether the ‘initial repertoire’ means current capabilities, products of installed construction methods or all histories admitted by the encompassing model; being representable in a law does not make a capability already operative. Construction: in matched histories with equal material, work and chain length, only the coupled one can extend; for any finite list of endpoints, the same local law constructs a route beyond it. In a companion contact model, the coincidence response formed by serial joining cannot be reproduced by any function of either single input, a change of functional kind that also keeps a real loss. Descriptive sufficiency is relative to the question domain: if cases with different actual responses are merged, a new relational distinction is needed. The three repairs are updating the state, adding distinctions and enlarging the question domain.

**Significance:** The theory no longer needs to identify formation with selection from a finite list of finished capabilities; ‘new possibilities’ must name actual changed relations and consequences rather than a larger label set.

**Scope:** 45 new theorems / 64 new audits (closure 92). The escape is from the frozen installed repertoire, not from the complete law that already includes coupling; an equivalent conventional graph-rewriting account reproduces the construction, and no predictive superiority is claimed. Unbounded qualitative innovation, the origin of every physical law and universal empirical coverage are not shown; novelty is not a universal ethical duty.

**Next:** The actual rate, retention and continuing effects of changed construction relations under real support, loss and competition, tested against matched conventional mechanisms.

**Argument:** Starting from ‘activity forms and changes the conditions of further activity’, the account connects: knower and known differentiate through actual access rather than as independent substances; differences acquire content while remaining fallible; an epistemic reason is more than a cause of belief; objectivity arises through differentiated access and correction; the field of inquiry can itself be corrected; knowledge has an ethical place under G0; wisdom joins grounded understanding, warranted concern and a feasible, authorized response; and non-self preserves particular lives in helping. Later sections settle the scope of living significance: consciousness differentiates significance within living relations without being its sole admission condition, and realized good, comparative improvement and duty require distinct judgments within one history. Whether conditional care exhausts the reasons about formation remains disputed.

**Significance:** It joins epistemology, inquiry, ethics and wisdom into one criticizable philosophical proposal that includes its own exposure to criticism.

**Scope:** Complete as a connected, defended synthesis; universal truth, exhaustive semantics and exclusive necessity are not established. Affirmative arguments can support each other cumulatively, but shared premises may not be counted repeatedly as independent evidence. The listed Lean modules are reused; the chapter adds no theorem.

**Next:** Inquiry’s authority alone has not established the whole practical package; the remaining work concerns the substantive grounds of actual denials, not mandatory use of this vocabulary or universal agreement.

<a id="plural-systems-and-correction"></a>
<a id="因应转化多系统共同试验与父子关系--responsive-transformation-plural-systems-shared-trials-and-parentsubsystem-relationships"></a>
## Responsive transformation: plural systems, shared trials and parent/subsystem relationships

**ID:** `plural-systems-and-correction` · **Category:** alignment

**Source:** [PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md](../chapters/PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md)

**Status:** Checked conditional results; unconditional corrigibility no longer the organizing demand

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `ac7eef13029a…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** This is the theory’s relational treatment of what alignment work calls corrigibility: requests, oversight, disagreement, interruption and revision occur within one changing activity, and their efficacy and warrant depend on cognition, circumstances and actual relations. Ren’s plural-system route shows that complementary observations compose an effective distinction no single position had, while any number of copies reporting the same condition do not; transfer of trial results needs grounds in a shared relation; several samples can be one source of error; and a parent system is a joint organization of actual relations, not automatically a sole subject or ruler. Deriving the correction boundary from relations: a closed chain has a consistent assignment exactly when its number of flips is even, so a relation can be repaired without replacing participants. Correction also depends on request history: a replacement route is built step by step while in-flight requests stay protected. Since 9 October the working term is ‘responsive transformation’ (因应转化): understanding, purposes and action reorganized through changing relations and consequences.

**Significance:** It reframes corrigibility from a permanent guarantee of an isolated AI into researchable relational conditions: when acquired grounds still apply, what relations reveal their loss of applicability, and how warranted revision enters activity without erasing prior effects or responsibilities.

**Scope:** Plural-system round 37 theorems / 58 audits; relational round 39/55; request-history round 33/62, with inherited counts listed separately. §§7, 11 and 14 record historical limits of particular models and do not require the inquiry to stop. The §15 condition table synthesizes established results; it is not a newly proved sufficient checklist, and no deployment is claimed.

**Next:** When acquired grounds still support an ongoing practice, which relations disclose their loss of applicability, and how a warranted revision enters activity; answers may be bounded guarantees, defeasible judgments or explicit limits.

<a id="practical-judgment"></a>
<a id="实践判断保留转化交接结束与责任--practical-judgment-preservation-transformation-transfer-ending-and-responsibility"></a>
## Practical judgment: preservation, transformation, transfer, ending and responsibility

**ID:** `practical-judgment` · **Category:** ethics

**Source:** [PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md](../chapters/PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md)

**Status:** General candidate complete under explicit axioms

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `be0b82567831…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** One generative ground supports preserving living relations that still support realization, transforming arrangements that obstruct them, transferring responsibility through an effective and justified succession, and ending forms whose continuation is no longer warranted; the name of the action decides nothing, what the whole history actually preserves, forms, damages and ends does. Beyond G0, the chapter openly adds J1 full comparison, J2 basic-condition priority (retaining other basic claims, restoring a threatened basic condition takes priority over optional enrichment, which cannot license imposed basic deprivation), J3 bounded responsibility, J4 practical selection and E correspondence. Comparison has two layers: protected basic claims first, then J1 on remaining gains and losses; crossed basic losses receive no manufactured total order. ‘Basic’ must be specified before the winner is chosen. Responsibility is differentiated by justified undertakings, formed dependence, control, responsive capacity and shared burdens; neither everyone equally nor the most capable without limit. Support acquires its reason through actual continuation when needed: the reason extends to support, repair or an adequate replacement, established by what continues, when support is needed, how continuation holds through the transition and whether the relevant lives can continue together, not by the survival of a particular institution or role.

**Significance:** It supplies the shared disclosed comparator and responsibility framework reused by alignment direction, basic conflict and goal revision, and argues for adopting J2 without treating its opponents as illogical.

**Scope:** J1–J4 are AI-proposed additional normative commitments, not deductions from G0 alone and not all Ren’s words. Lean checks conditional consequences for strict comparison, finite alternatives, joint requirements, allocation, transfer and discharge; it does not defend the premises. No universal total ranking, correctness of arbitrary thresholds, full implementation or axiom-free warrant is claimed. Shared-kitchen calibration (9 theorems / 20 audits) and published-evidence constraints are listed separately. In the unified structure G0 is folded into significance (a condition in Part I, yielded by Part II's one axiom); the timely-continuation section is an application argument with no new theorem.

**Next:** The universal practical warrant remains open; crossed basic claims continue in the basic-conflict chapter.

## Connections among proved results

**ID:** `proved-connections` · **Category:** formal index

**Source:** [PROVED-CONNECTIONS.md](../history/PROVED-CONNECTIONS.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Targeted dependency audit and one new formal connection

**Argument:** Four statuses are distinguished: proved composition (a producer result enters a consumer with matched meanings and guards), argued correspondence, supplied premise (a local input, not thereby external to generative reality) and unresolved connection; several separately proved theorems are not thereby connected. The audit table gives the established status and remaining obligation for connections such as common presentation → supported organization, formation → prediction → correction → productive use, consequence → method revision, evaluative influence → changed action, new organization → new capacity → changed description, and evidence → exact discrimination. The new composition: calibrated error and sufficient response supply imply the threshold after the guarded, work-charged response event; in a three-plan menu with both readout cases live, the fixed unit response is the unique undefeated plan under J2; admitting a fourth policy that reads the acquired record leaves both it and the fixed response undefeated, so necessity changes with a new feasible alternative while the protected target does not.

**Significance:** It prevents treating separately proved theorems as connected and re-reporting connected mechanisms as gaps, and shows that a warranted practical reason must track a jointly feasible, timely response through the same history that obtains and uses evidence.

**Scope:** A targeted audit, not an exhaustive census of systems theories or a retrospective certification of all proofs. Fresh build: 31 theorems / 48 audits; 317 audits across seven imported modules. The plan menu, readout relations and selector are supplied; immediate response is not compared with inquiry.

**Next:** Form evidence-justified uncertainty sets and alternatives, then select inquiry or earlier response under a common physical deadline; measured-feedback correspondence continues the real-world link.

<a id="relations-across-scales"></a>
<a id="尺度之间的关系--relations-across-scales"></a>
## Relations across scales

**ID:** `relations-across-scales` · **Category:** mechanism mathematics

**Source:** [RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES.md](../chapters/RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES.md)

**Status:** Checked conditional results and scoped empirical correspondence

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `ef4f0355d83b…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Whether a description at one scale suffices depends on which relations it preserves through actual change and which judgment it must support: a coarser description can be accurate enough, while an exact prediction of a total can still omit a basic loss at a particular position; changing organization can require more information, a shorter horizon or recalibration. Following Ren’s clarification, cells participate in organs, organs in bodies and bodies in ecosystems, with cognition and activity selection occurring within these relations; a part is not merely inside a larger container, and nesting coexists with crossing, migration, competition and cooperation. Later sections treat approximate preservation over a finite horizon; choice changing error propagation; acquired evidence, revised description and enacted response; when to inquire and when to respond (a distinction matters when histories compatible with current evidence demand incompatible responses, while acquiring information also changes the history in which the response must occur); how long a description stays usable; continuation adequacy, joint continuation and grounded mutual continuation; and an atomic check-and-reserve that changes the actual availability relation so that support survives every finite admitted change history.

**Significance:** It tests that judgments about wholes stay accountable to differentiated consequences: a correct total does not replace protection at each position, and the needed detail and lifetime of a description vary with responses, conditions and deadlines.

**Scope:** Sections carry their own Lean receipts (for example evidence through change, 15 theorems / 15 audits, 10 empty and 5 propext-only) and empirical integrations; public-data comparisons are secondary analyses. No new proof of G0 or ethical weighting rule follows; ‘more detailed’ is relative to the map, not an ultimate microscopic ontology. Full experimental validation remains a selected, unfinished target.

**Next:** How actual feedback distinguishes an omitted change range, a false reading and an execution deviation, connected to existing revision mechanisms.

**Lean correspondence:** [RelationsAcrossScales.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/RelationsAcrossScales.lean) · [EmbodiedChoiceScales.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/EmbodiedChoiceScales.lean) · [ScaleRevision.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/ScaleRevision.lean) · [OrganizedScaleLoop.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/OrganizedScaleLoop.lean) · [InquiryChoice.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/InquiryChoice.lean) · [ChangingDependency.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/ChangingDependency.lean) · [ContinuationAdequacy.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/ContinuationAdequacy.lean) · [JointContinuation.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/JointContinuation.lean) · [SeededContinuation.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/SeededContinuation.lean) · [EvidenceThroughChange.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/systems-complexity/analysis/EvidenceThroughChange.lean)

<a id="scientific-philosophy"></a>
<a id="科学哲学与探究的生成条件--scientific-philosophy-and-inquirys-generative-conditions"></a>
## Scientific philosophy and inquiry’s generative conditions

**ID:** `scientific-philosophy` · **Category:** philosophical epistemic

**Source:** [SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY.md](../chapters/SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY.md)

**Status:** Bounded argument; fallible-inquiry necessary constraint checked

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `710e7a7f275e…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** If a philosophy affirms an empirical capability under its actual laws, it cannot coherently deny independently established information, implementation or support requirements. A generative account connects evidence, inference, action and rule revision; compatibility neither guarantees truth nor entails the whole proposed ontology. On the unified spine, where two frames are determined up to likeness, agreeing on every finite move-course possibility and every endpoint claim is being alike, so an adequate rival must preserve that structure though not our vocabulary; registration, testing, generalization and bounded identification each give their own necessary relations; a distinction must arrive in time to change a response; and claimed scientific standing needs inspectable grounds for its distinctions and operative routes from relevant defeats to revision.

**Significance:** Makes the compatibility conjecture answerable to capability-specific necessity tests.

**Scope:** Conceptual analysis, historical hand arguments and primary comparison are complete. The 8 October fallible-inquiry necessary constraint is Lean-checked (18 theorems/27 audits; record finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity). Applying its finite law tables needs empirical warrant; science-wide necessity and uniqueness of the whole core remain unproved (scientific-inquiry-foundation stays open). The fallible-inquiry constraint is extended on the spine: operative connectivity (13 theorems), common residual exchange (15 theorems) and timely routes (25 theorems). By Ren's 13 October correction, full-core scientific necessity is a revisable hypothesis, not a premise; the demarcation standard is a proposal with author counterreview, not a universal theorem.

**Next:** Ongoing: indispensability of each core commitment across science (the universal target remains open). Proposed: fix a disputed core commitment and test whether the same scientific achievement survives its genuine removal; warrant initial-evidence pairing and command execution at a declared stage; obtain empirical warrant for the law tables.

<a id="shengsheng"></a>
<a id="生生活动怎样形成进一步活动--生生-how-activity-forms-further-activity"></a>
## 生生: how activity forms further activity

**ID:** `shengsheng` · **Category:** synthesis

**Source:** [SHENGSHENG.md](../history/SHENGSHENG.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Connected mechanistic articulation complete

**Argument:** Principle: activity forms and transforms the conditions of further activity. 生生 names the unfolding in which differences produced by activity persist or transform, participate in later activity, and form, sustain or change the relations through which further activity becomes possible; organization, life, knowing and care differentiate within it, and the formation, persistence and good direction of each need their own explanation. ‘Activity’ requires no intention or constituted actor, and ‘conditions’ means enabling or constraining relations actually identified; the central demand is to trace what an activity leaves operative and how that changes later occurrence or possibility. An organization is identified through relations that keep performing a specified role across change: identical parts do not guarantee identical organization, and overall connectedness does not equalize real losses at different positions. Retained consequence is distinguished from regeneration. The chapter gives one worked, actually joined formation–learning history, the possibility of further formation, the relation to the mathematical core, correspondence requirements, and 生生 as an ethical direction (G0).

**Significance:** The conceptual and mechanistic companion to the mathematical core: articulating 生生 is not renaming every change, but explaining which activities formed which actual relations and how those relations make later activity possible, testable and correctable.

**Scope:** An explanatory synthesis, not a new omnibus theorem, experiment or claim of historical priority; inherited mathematics keeps its checked scope. Universal empirical coverage, the origin of all physical laws, phenomenal experience, guaranteed favorable evolution, autonomous ethical discovery and generally wise AI are not established. The three foundational premises are provisional, not a proved uniquely minimal axiom set.

**Next:** Revision routes are listed: a formative relation may prove inert, a learned influence may be preinstalled, a handoff may fail, a normative application may lack authority or misdescribe the loss, or a simpler account may keep all explanatory content. The Theory of Becoming now unifies this articulation.

<a id="sustained-living-judgment"></a>
<a id="持续的生活组织与共同实践判断--sustained-living-organization-and-collective-practical-judgment"></a>
## Sustained living organization and collective practical judgment

**ID:** `sustained-living-judgment` · **Category:** ethical mechanism

**Source:** [SUSTAINED-LIVING-JUDGMENT.md](../history/SUSTAINED-LIVING-JUDGMENT.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Checked conditional result; independently reviewed

**Argument:** When a continuation has justified basic standing and an authorized, jointly feasible route preserves the other basic claims, collective judgment should retain or reconstruct the organizational relations that actually enable it and provide support at the relevant times; who contributes what depends further on justified commitments, authority, capacities and cumulative burdens. What is protected is the actual continuation of living, not the permanent survival of the original institution, provider or technique. Formally, along the actual catalytic recipe the organizing component participates and remains while each operation consumes one substrate and one support unit; for any finite number of operations one inventory history is constructed without resetting spent stock. A temporal extension openly adds a local rate bound and an epoch-realizability assumption: with the same two units of provision, one competent unit meets two successive single demands but misses a double demand in one epoch. The general inference is justified basic protection → exclusion of avoidable failure without other basic cost → necessary conditions of joint realization → bounded allocation.

**Significance:** It joins sustained living organization, explicit protection principles and collective allocation, and prevents nominal fulfillment, approval or assigned responsibility from being taken as actual continuation of living.

**Scope:** 29 new theorems / 39 new audits (192 including imports); the independent completion review accepted the repaired account. The rate is a local law awaiting calibration, not a biological law derived from stoichiometry; toy units cannot be identified with crops, carers or institutions. Full living-domain coverage, autonomous organization, infinite continuation, universal compliance and real allocation are not completed.

**Next:** Prospective testing in a specified shared practice: measured competence/delivery and stage demand → authorized enactment → actual protection and contributor burden; correspondence cannot be promoted to empirical validation before that test.

<a id="system-individuation"></a>
<a id="系统怎样形成其边界与可能性--systems-constitutive-relationships-and-possible-change"></a>
## Systems, constitutive relationships and possible change

**ID:** `system-individuation` · **Category:** foundation

**Source:** [SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION.md](../history/SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Connected explanatory candidate complete; stronger foundational obligation open

**Argument:** A system is a distinguishable organization of relations within one unfolding, whose organization helps explain what can occur together, what can follow and how those possibilities change; boundaries, composition and persistence must be warranted by actual relations. Identify the phenomenon before choosing the boundary; constitutive participation differs from predictive success, since a correlated record can predict a command equally well without being read. A boundary articulates the dependencies being followed and may nest or overlap; if two cases share a proposed description yet permit different relevant continuations, the description needs another distinction, a narrower scope or retained uncertainty. Organization makes possibilities concrete through actual operations: separately available parts need not be jointly usable, a formed connection can make an operation feasible, and loss or reorganization can remove it. Core and tree are different articulations of one unfolding, and systems inquiry subjects general statements to particular relations.

**Significance:** It answers Ren’s systems question without imposing autonomy, feedback, self-maintenance or a unique boundary on every legitimate use of ‘system’, and without letting ‘it is a system’ supply warrant automatically.

**Scope:** 27 new theorems / 41 declaration audits, all empty, with 18 inherited declarations rechecked: when sufficient regions intersect, and correlated states with two sufficient regions but no least one. These concern sufficient descriptions and do not derive causal constitution from correlation. No new axiom; no impossibility claim about the stronger target.

**Next:** Warrant the actual relations, the range of admissible variation and the recognition and inference used to attribute them throughout the intended foundational scope; continued in the system-warrant chapter.

<a id="system-warrant"></a>
<a id="系统关系与可行变化怎样获得根据--grounding-system-relationships-and-admissible-variations"></a>
## Grounding system relationships and admissible variations

**ID:** `system-warrant` · **Category:** foundation

**Source:** [SYSTEM-WARRANT.md](../history/SYSTEM-WARRANT.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Local dependency discharged; stronger foundational scope open

**Argument:** A relation earns its explanatory role through evidence of actual participation; a variation earns admissibility through an identified realization or a warranted route to it; the strength and scope of conclusions must match those grounds. Occurrence, present possibility, sufficiency for a selected answer, exclusion and exact characterization are different claims needing different grounds; complete identification of every possibility is required only for a claim of completeness. In the existing Boolean example the comparison domain is no longer an independently chosen input: it is exactly what is reachable after the actual correlate event of the unchanged process, with exclusion and realization both derived. A reversible redescription preserves every state, transition and history, yet an independent reset becomes a nonfactorizable copying relation in mixed coordinates, so independence of a coordinate update is relative to aspect meanings; for a deterministic operation, its merged-result relation identifies which input distinctions its output does not retain.

**Significance:** It shows that correspondence can obtain substantive local warrant without first exhausting every possibility, while preventing one successful record from certifying occurrence, present feasibility, universality and impossibility at once.

**Scope:** Variation warrant: 19 theorems / 21 audits, all empty (59 inherited listed separately); aspect distinctions 19/25; operation roles 28 theorems with 111 new and inherited reports empty. The TCLab and bacterial oxygen studies support actual participation and joint variation at their interfaces. The Boolean laws are explicit mathematical controls, not a claim that every actual system has these coordinates or operations.

**Next:** Select a specific claimed extension and test whether its actual preparation, continuing mechanism and joint constraints support it; reuse what is established and leave the rest open, without making completed mechanisms wait for an unrelated global guarantee.

## Systems, complexity and chaos within generative grounding

**ID:** `systems-complexity-chaos` · **Category:** mathematics

**Source:** [SYSTEMS-COMPLEXITY-CHAOS.md](../history/SYSTEMS-COMPLEXITY-CHAOS.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Checked conditional formal result

**Argument:** Organization determines valid reduced dynamics; delay changes stability, finite complete state bounds long-run behavior, and an infinite symbolic shift exhibits chaos. Exact correspondence with generative histories plus consequence-guided revision and support accounting permits analysis of recurrent regulation and failure.

**Significance:** Connects concrete mathematics across fields while preserving their distinct questions.

**Scope:** 104 initial plus 58 continuation theorems: 162 distinct Lean results. Chaos is proved for the symbolic shift, not Lorenz flow or an empirical learner. Separately counted 8 October packages: relations across scales (21), scale revision (27), inquiry choice (28), changing dependencies (25), system individuation (27/41 audits) and variation warrant (19/21); none is added into the 162.

**Next:** Ongoing: actual system boundaries, causal attribution and universal warrant for ranges of variation. Proposed: identify delay, gain, disturbance and renewal in an actual process and test correspondence.
