<a id="the-theory-of-becoming"></a>
<a id="生成变化之论--the-theory-of-becoming"></a>
## The Theory of Becoming

**ID:** `the-theory-of-becoming` · **Category:** synthesis

**Source:** [THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md](../chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md)

**Status:** Canonical entry; conditional results checked, whole deduction open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `35f9576e1a10…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** The Theory of Becoming explains formation, persistence, transformation, degeneration and dissolution within one relational unfolding, and how life, evolution, knowing and evaluation differentiate within it, without first assuming that becoming is good. Ren’s words separate two targets: the deductive necessity of the whole without added substantive axioms (the open first priority), and the ethical orientation within the whole through G0 and disclosed practical premises (complete at its declared conditions; G0 is now a theorem of Part II's one axiom, not an axiom). A premise card names each logical, dynamical, correspondence, ethical and practical premise with its Lean name, and lists what is not assumed. Some laws hold of every unfolding with no premise about it: arising and ceasing, a dependence forming and dissolving, and coming to stand and ceasing to stand are readings of one change; no amount falls below zero, so in a finite family recurring falls need recurring rises; and in a finite family coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace, so with finitely many formations arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; every law of change, also with no premise: within finitely many configurations a sequence revisits from every step on, and never revisiting needs openness; under a determined law a lost possibility stays lost, and within finitely many configurations merging nothing is exactly every configuration returning and exactly keeping every possibility, so a rise needs a merge; a law keeping its history merges nothing and never returns, which needs openness; every other law names its premise. Dependence itself belongs to the unfolding: it forms, holds, breaks and dissolves across steps, and theorems connect three outcomes of a loss (ending, transformation, restoration) that the reading of the break does not decide; activity only where supported is exactly the zero reserve, and with a reserve the endings after a loss and after coextinction are deferred, not escaped, under a decaying reserve coextinction runs down a chain of dependence of any length within a bound at each link, and without decay, with excluded middle as a hypothesis, each link still ends, while a step after which a formation is never active needs omniscience in general (the limited principle of omniscience); identity across steps is supplied by the representation: labels carry nothing while the pattern of names across steps carries identity; each step's relations, each condition's class and “more” do not depend on it while a formation's class, undermining and arising do; continuity read one way constrains it up to succession, and read both ways up to succession across dormancy; and under a census, with each formation listed once in the flow and Taking, every continuation without splits makes more force arising, no split being sufficient over a run and not necessary, while across one step it is exactly the condition; the census laws hold under every continuation in two halves, ceasing recurring needing arising recurring without splits and, under a bounded count, arising recurring needing ceasing recurring without merges, one unfolding read as budding or as joining defeating one half each. A whole is active exactly while some part is, a coincidence of activity, and where parts are brief, or end with finitely many active at once, a whole persists only through their generation. Renewal is graded by return time, consumption being exactly a dependence that never returns; no finite history decides whether drawing renews or consumes; under overdetermination move-relative but-for difference-making comes apart from relational participation; substitution preserves consumption on the whole-run reading; when arising depletes a finite family of conditions, unceasing generation needs renewal to recur, while renewal does not imply generation; in balanced flows, generation more without end needs replenishment and renewers with no eventual bound and, under a census of active formations with each formation listed once in the flow and Taking, strictly implies unceasing generation; under dissipation, which binds at steps where some finite family is closed and there makes giving need uptake, a finite family on which taking recurs, whether from more, generation or maintenance, with every finite family containing it, is open at arbitrarily late steps and, enclosed around, draws in from beyond itself; formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum, the two-kind representation embedding in the one-kind reading in which no formation is a condition, which condition is which relatum being supplied by the shared index, and where activity needs support a formation depending on an embodied relatum lives only while it does, a relatum's ending ends every formation whose chain of dependence reaches it, and in a balanced flow in which only active formations give an embodied relatum arises only as another active relatum gives to it, which need not be embodied, its arising is its coming to stand and so is itself replenishment, a requirement that follows standing, not activity, and under dissipation a finite family in which embodied members keep arising is open and, enclosed around, draws in; and what C ranks depends on the reading it compares: under the stepwise reading it still ranks sharing above winning by consumption and, in the two-part family, restraint above overdraw, but no longer ranks the absence of an overdrawing formation with a credited event before the loss above its occurrence; and under the correspondence discipline that a condition relates two events only when one draws on it and the other depends on it at a positive level, idle conditions no longer connect for free, connection through a condition is made by its living use, and formations bearing on themselves relate directly, with no third condition; read with one kind of relatum, living on and descent are two candidate readings of related beside interaction, connecting mutualists that depend only on each other and generations each given by the one before, and adopting them is Ren's choice. Across a step at which a family is dissipated on, balance makes a member rising come with another falling, and generation's depletion premise follows for an event at whose steps the family is dissipated on and taken from; evolution through descent has a minimal formal content on the core: an arithmetic identity with no premise (Price's equation in counting form, whose total weighted by offspring is not the selection term proper), and, where only active formations give and activity needs support, only supported formations leave descendants, a transmitted need exceeds the giving step's level by at most the bound of transmission, and activity in between sets later selection; fitness is not defined and transmission is a premise. The space is every world: the laws with no premise hold of every world, and seven premises are each met by some worlds and not by others, so premises carve parts; in a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (asked of every finite world without decidability, the law is equivalent to excluded middle, and with excluded middle as a hypothesis it holds of every finite world in the pure core; this reads activity, with the English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed, the Chinese being the AI's rendering, and whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose, Ren having written “generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”), the part in which every event is living crosses recurring arising and recurring ceasing, and dissipation brings a finite, balanced world whose arising is embodied to rest, with no decision procedure. Among the premises, activity needing support makes activity carried, embodiment makes whatever arises embodied, a finite world whose activity is decided has a census, and in a finite world only active relata taking under dissipation makes only active relata give; the remaining eight, with a census and bounded transmission, are independent relative to one another, each failed by a world meeting the other seven, one world meets them all, in another each of the eight binds (that world not finite only through idle relata, three ever active), and a finite world which meets them comes to rest. What brings a world to rest is not finiteness but finitely many standing at each step, with enclosure: under balance and dissipation the total standing does not rise across an enclosed step and any change of standing lowers it; under a census of what is active, recurring ceasing needs recurring arising, and not conversely, while under a census returning within some number at arbitrarily late steps the two recur together (finite worlds being one case and the infinite procession, with one relatum active at a time, another), and under one growing without end, however slowly, arising can go on without ceasing, the census law holding of any determination whose holders are listed at each step, read of activity, standing and dependence, with the count balancing exactly over any stretch: the list at the end with what ceased is the list at the start with what came, and the recurrence laws follow from this balance; the tally, the balance with no more ceasing across a step than were listed before it, is the whole law of counting: every tally of members kept, ceasing and coming is counted by a queue, premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free, the two together, with only active relata giving, bind it, and under all eight premises the laws of counting are the tally and that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, with a change bound added under enclosure from some step on and in finite worlds: the relata active together with the steps of change stay within the total standing at enclosure; so a world with censuses of what is active and of what stands, whose arising is embodied, comes to rest once every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands (the rest theorem), with finite worlds and worlds whose relata are all embodied as its two cases and both censuses needed: the world itself need not be finite, but finitely many must stand and finitely many be active at each step, and in a world that so comes to rest not unboundedly many relata ever stand or act; in such a world the exchange comes to rest too, needing only the census of what stands, balance, dissipation and enclosure, without any one of which it can recur; one world meeting all eight premises with no step enclosed keeps arising, another never arises, and one meeting all eight with every step enclosed comes to rest, as does one in which each binds, so recurring arising needs openness, openness with the eight does not suffice for it, and the eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness. What can form next (Part I, P37): levels admit a formation when they meet its every requirement; where requirements do not loosen, support is gained only from the supported, and with nothing given from beyond the end absorbs, each premise with a counterexample; with a part withheld and the rest of the exchange unchanged, the levels without it are unique where they exist and the difference is exact, a formation is supported exactly when the part's cumulative net draw stays within the margin (the phase boundary is exact), so a part closes what can form only through a net draw beyond the margin on a required condition and opens it only through a net give; compared by inclusion a part widens, narrows, keeps the same or is mixed, a mixed part is not ordered by inclusion, and ordering it needs a measure; over nested regions of formations the smaller the region the more lies beyond it and nothing lies beyond the whole, and the clearer continues within its dependence while closing the dweller beyond it; renewal over a region of conditions is renewal at the step only where the region covers what the formation takes part in, a region covering what it requires and not what it takes part in can keep it while it undermines another, and one omitting what it requires can lose it its own support; reading widening, narrowing and keeping the same as generative, degenerative and neutral, and regions as self, system and whole, is the AI's reading, pending Ren. What each premise adds (Part I, P38): under the 256 selections of the eight premises the laws of counting are of two kinds, the tally alone or the tally with nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active, the second exactly where balance and embodiment are selected with only active relata giving, or with both only active relata taking and dissipation (the second route needs no active giver: at a step at which nothing is active nothing is taken, and dissipation lets nothing be given without taking to the closed family of the relata active after it); with enclosure from some step on, a change bound is added exactly where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected; every step of a finite world is enclosed, and there the count is bounded, nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active where balance and embodiment are selected with only active relata giving or with dissipation, and change is bounded from the first step where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected, so in finite worlds the 256 selections give three kinds of law, and finite and enclosed worlds have the same laws exactly where the selection bounds change and binds counting (P38b, witnessed by rings seating a queue's members in turn); where every premise binds, the laws of counting under the eight add only that something arises, and binding decides neither rest nor change without end (P38c, binding meaning that each premise's condition has an instance, witnessed by a queue closed once; no finite world binds every premise); where the premises of each selection bind, at most three more laws: something is active, something arises, and something arises across a step at which something is active, each characterized by exactly the selections adding it, and in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds only that something arises (P45, witnessed with saturated webs, a lossy queue and a relay); with enclosure from some step on, where every premise binds, only that something arises is added as well, and in finite worlds, where the premises of each selection without the census bind, at most the same three, the third under more selections there since every step is enclosed, while with enclosure from some step on, where the premises of each selection bind, each is added under the same selections as where nothing is enclosed, since what arises may arise before enclosure (P46, witnessed with rings, and under enclosure also with a queue whose front sheds a spare unit). Read of what stands, the laws are those of activity where nothing is enclosed, and with enclosure from some step on and in finite worlds embodiment is not needed where balance and dissipation bind, since under enclosure balance and dissipation alone bound the change of what stands and embodiment carries the bound to what is active; read of dependence, the premises add no law (P47, witnessed by a queue fed from a source, waiting queues, a ring active throughout, and a queue and a ring depending on a common condition standing at one and active throughout, every dependence met). These laws are all corollaries of the laws of one step: each holds of every world with the condition its proof uses stated inside it; balance at a step fixes coming to stand and ceasing to stand exactly, across a step at which a family holding what stands runs down some standing changes exactly when the total falls, change recurs exactly where it recurs across steps that do not run down, running down bounds change, and ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps; where the premises hold at every step these conditions hold everywhere, and no premise is derived (P48). So are the laws of dependence, reserve and support and the census balance, each with its condition inside it, the originals their corollaries (P50). So are the remaining laws of rest, openness and replenishment, the laws of the whole and the census law under a continuation (P57, P60, P61): every group of the inventory is localized. So are reserve and dependence (P63) and the converse of P61 (P61b); at coarser steps the laws of one step hold where their conditions compose, and nothing composes back to the fine steps (Sampling); at finer units they hold with change read in the unit, a need counted in the same unit as the level (Units); continuous time is a tower of ever finer discrete readings, the changes bounded independently of the level (Tower). The boundary condition for 无明 needs no axiom: under a determined law, seeking comes to rest exactly when it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged meeting its target, "more than now" needs an open world, and where what stands is listed, rising without end needs steps at which it does not run down; where a target's carriers leave more offspring its share rises, and where the next configuration depends on the rule, reforming the state alone is re-absorbed (P62; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren). Decidedness made local (P58): a proposition is decided where it holds or fails, which is not a decision procedure; a count is a relation, existing exactly where what it counts is decided; the census between counts, the never-stopping forms of recurrence in finite families and the rest theorems need no decidedness, it being unrefutable that an amount that does not rise stops falling from some step on; what the rest theorems prove is that the world resting from some step on cannot be refuted, and those proving only non-recurrence are named so (P58c); the theorems still using it state it as their own condition, and the inventory gives each one's reason (counting, objects built by deciding, finding a step or member, telling same from different, building a list, splitting on a case). Imbalance as a relatum (P59): the difference is counted as the exchange of one more relatum, never active and requiring nothing, so every flow balances, equivalent step by step to the representation as it is; adoption is Ren's. Selection, response, mechanism and attraction need no axiom: a selection through a selector's registration selects two histories alike exactly when the selector registers them alike, so with the rest fixed it is blind beyond the registration closure; where the rest responds through its registration, a supplied premise, the comparison is decided within the part's responsive reach; a projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike, what the step does not depend on is re-absorbed in one step, and the standard causal model x′ = F(x, u, ε) is a determined process whose move is the input and the noise; for every determined law a configuration is drawn into an absorbing region exactly where it does not return (P64–P68; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren). Responses as the dynamics give need no axiom: where the rest follows one law of exchange reading what has stood, two balanced flows in which the part acts alike are one flow, the course the law generates balances exactly where it is feasible, and the counterfactual of an act is that course; where the law reads only what each formation registers, responding through registration is a theorem, with finitely many conditions the least registration being what the law is sensitive to, so the comparison is decided within the responsive reach with neither the second flow nor the response supplied; an act not taken is an intervention of the standard causal model (P80; the law is supplied, and the readings are the AI's, pending Ren). The labelled process and the frame are readings of one unfolding, a world, with no premise: read within the configuration the move changes no run and is what the law leaves open, and a world's move is its relata's exchange; every history is a run of the law it shows, the least one, determined exactly where the history is consistent, the correspondence failing to be an identity through dead ends and splices; a claim is a relatum and novelty is arising; configurations are alike where a bisimulation relates them, and a description makes sense exactly where it identifies the alike ones (P69; Ren agreed that law and history are one unfolding read two ways, “there are no two realities”; the other readings are the AI's, pending Ren). Earlier giving can meet later need through a condition carried across steps: the least feeding closure so extended contains the same-step closure, strictly through storage. Local balance exactly characterizes meeting a need; redundant feeders can stand in for one another. Possible carrying does not identify actual origin, and support is not sufficient for activity (P86). Keeping the names of what holds fixes classes through held dormancy; balanced re-identifications lie exactly within conservation, distinct standings fix identity and equal standings leave choice; holding readings, undermining and a mixed census remain open (P87). For a symmetric joining relation and a finite stretch of naturally named exchanges, arrangements are reachable exactly where they orient joined pairs alike. Decided apartness for distinct exchanges gives a lexicographically least, idempotent normal form; reachability is agreement of forms, and a natural-number-valued complete invariant compared on the finite stretch needs exactly that decision. Every reordering with split sides preserves activity and standing census existence both ways; arbitrary commutation preserves it forward. Decided idleness at every step and relatum gives the least containing footprint, whose joining and order are contained in every containing footprint’s. With decidable equality of relata, existence of a least Boolean containing footprint is equivalent to decided idleness. The normal form depends on names and a finite stretch; no unnamed, Foata-layer or unbounded form is supplied. No decision is derived for actual worlds and no concrete undecidable-idleness world is given. The sides of reordering remain supplied; continuous-time correspondence remains open. The readings are the AI’s, pending Ren. (P88). A list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided (`listsOnce_iff_decided`); its number of members is unique and exists exactly then. Refutation laws need no such premise. Fixing every list's number up to relational indiscernibility in every world is equivalent to excluded middle (`World.numbers_indiscernible_iff_em`). Reading by occurrence keeps amounts and local laws without tracking occurrences across steps. (P77). Stuttering keeps the premises, stretch totals and recurrence, while rates and reserves counted in steps depend on the reading. For a given footprint containing the exchanges, commuting unjoined neighbouring exchanges keeps every premise and reaches exactly the renumberings preserving the partial order of joined exchanges (`Footprinted.sorts_iff`, `Footprinted.converse`). Removing idle steps keeps premises, censuses and totals. (P78). A pattern of one step is realized by a world exactly where it obeys the law of every step and the law of each named local condition (`OneStep.every_iff`, `OneStep.laws`); nonzero taking needs a taker and nonzero giving a giver. Givers, capacity and activity are characterized exactly. Runs on one family add chaining; for families chosen step by step, running down adds continuity counted at positive levels (`OneStep.step_runsDown_iff`), strictly weaker than tracking positions. (P79). Given weights with their laws and finite lists of moves and configurations, the sum of histories over a finite horizon is exactly stepwise transfer (`Weights.sum_courses`). Possibility is the core's trace relation, and counting preserves possibility. For a description with representatives, exact preservation at every horizon is exactly one-step lumpability (`Weights.lumped_iff`); truncation, cancellation, unkept memory and loops have explicit boundary witnesses. (P82). Transmission is exactly inheritance with a need bound (`Flow.transmitsWithin_iff`); where no dependence was held before, inheritance is the forming law, while the general forming/holding split uses decidedness. Dropping one dependence of a giver keeps the other premises and breaks binding transmission (`World.drop_but`). Under the named finite, balance, dissipation, embodiment and support conditions, a reading of drawing together with drawing being depending derives transmission (`World.transmitting_of_drawn`). (P84). `Successive.relay` gives a balanced, dissipative flow in which only active formations give, the pool is fed at every step, and each source participates and is active at its own step only. Continuing to be fed needs no source formation to recur. This advances continuing-self-fed-from-beyond and is not a separate result. (P85). The weights, footprints and local conditions are supplied as named; no actual correspondence or ethical judgment follows. Dead ends and splices are the whole law of law and history: a family of histories is a law's exactly where it holds its splices, two laws admit the same histories exactly where they have the same live steps, and where both frames are determined up to likeness tests fix likeness (P76). Where the course branches, every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return, possibly drawn allows return on another course, keeping every possibility does not give returning, and determinacy is the named case of determinacy up to likeness (P81; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren). Learning needs no axiom: no record fixes the next value, also among worlds held by a list, and every learner has a course refuting each of its claims, the registration of a law keeping its record, so open; learning by refutation never passes a hypothesis that holds, and where a list holds the world it is refuted a bounded number of times, its coming to rest unrefuted and when it rests not registered; a lumping determines exactly the inputs it lumps with the data and is right exactly where the world goes alike across it, structure and change being one lumping; the earlier acquisition chain and connectionist models are instances (P73, P74; 理 is read as Ren reads it, the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; the other readings are the AI's, pending Ren). These laws complete the formal part of the root of wisdom at the scope Part I reaches, the correspondence of actual formation remaining open (P75). A formation can test only a claim that differs in what registers in it (P49, not entered here before). What the one axiom yields (section 6.8, P39): Ren's axiom is read as boundary neutrality for the significance of continuation: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step; on every reading in which a claim's significance is that of a formation's continuation at a step (the stepwise, relation and whole-run readings among them), G0, S0 at every standpoint, both neutralities and a seed follow with no connection used, and on level paths C follows too, with better read as retaining and adding what has significance; at the level of claims this is immediate, G0 being the axiom restricted to living claims; under the axiom retaining what has significance is inclusion, and a part loses a continuation with significance exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin and adds one exactly where its net exchange brings a formation within it; a preempting drawer, taking a condition before any dependence on it forms, is living on the stepwise reading yet loses a possibility, so the two readings of not harm differ; what retains in the whole retains within every region and not conversely: centers bounded by their dependence license the free rider and disagree, while under the axiom the free rider's part loses the dweller from every standpoint and withholding it ends nothing; where nothing has significance nothing is ordered, so the axiom is needed; these readings are the AI's, pending Ren. How far the route without axiom reaches (Part I's feeding and return, route (b), P40): what a continuation depends on is its feeding closure, the least region holding it that is closed under feeding, reached with no premise, and nothing beyond the closure gives to what it requires; under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, consumption whose feeders are all unsupported lasts at most as many steps as the level of what it consumes, so a loss within the closure can return through a feeder, even to a formation that kept its own support across the step, while a loss beyond it need not return; significance bounded by the whole is the axiom, and where the losses lie within a region the verdict bounded by it is the axiom's, so always where the feeding closure is the whole, while in the clearer's web the two part; so route (b) reaches the self and what it depends on, and the whole only where the whole is one feeding closure, and what the axiom adds is significance for continuations whose loss returns to no one; these readings are the AI's, pending Ren. Feedback and reach (Part I, P42): closures under a relation unify the levels: the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, what can affect a formation, and the influence and reach closures, the reach closure being what the formation's exchange can affect link by link, lie within the system, the closure under sharing a condition; each inclusion can be strict, and one common condition makes the system the whole; in a balanced flow a formation's support registers only its exchanges with what it depends on, so a part beyond its influence closure is not registered within it; for any significance covering what a part has reached before each step, the comparison with and without the part is the axiom's, and the comparison of any two flows that start alike is decided within what their difference reaches; the comparison by withheld levels holds the rest of the exchange fixed, so effects through others' responses do not register in it; the system does not read Ren's “the system that one is in”, for which the reach closure is offered, and P40's reading of the feeding closure as that system is withdrawn; these readings are the AI's, pending Ren. The axiom decomposed (section 6.11, P43): along a relation, a boundary of the self is a region holding it and closed under the relation; a claim about the self is super-true when it holds at every admissible boundary, sub-true when it holds at some, and boundary-invariant when holding at one means holding at every one; the presupposition that everything within the boundary has significance is, sub-true, significance on the closure, route (b) being the least significance making every presupposition sub-true, and, super-true, the axiom, so route (b) and the axiom are one presupposition at narrow and at wide scope; where the whole is admissible the axiom is exactly the presupposition, sub-true and invariant at every standpoint, invariance is exactly the conditional from the presupposition to the axiom at that standpoint, and given the presupposition everywhere and covering it is standpoint invariance, the rule N_std, so the decomposition locates the step carrying all of the axiom's content beyond the presupposition and does not lower the axiom; a presupposition sub-true along affecting compares every part within the reach closure as the axiom does, with no invariance; both were checked by the sixteenth independent review, whose sixteen findings were handled before integration; G0's uses (section 6.12, P44): every use of G0 in the core and the periphery is audited, and the audit is clean: each takes G0 as a hypothesis for an arbitrary positive relevance, and positive relevance read from significance, realized living content whose continuation has significance from every standpoint, satisfies G0 under the axiom and is the least that does, so the axiom discharges every use, the Bridge stating it for the periphery's interface; the axiom is G0 for anything, with “positive” weakened to “has significance”; the reason premise A must be read on living content, since with bare significance it gives a reason for any new content, and so read the universal reason follows from the axiom with no seed, neutrality or connection premise; read on possibilities, the formations a course's levels admit, C under the axiom is retaining and adding what has significance, ranks the absence of overdraw, restraint and sharing as the whole-run reading does while withholding no event, and leaves a presence that adds no possibility unranked against its absence, while possibilities first ranks that presence higher and a rest below activity; the readings and names are the AI's, pending Ren; not yet independently reviewed. G0 folded (P51): after the audit Ren folded G0, and it is no longer an axiom; Part I states it as a condition, its content characterized with no axiom (a seed with both neutralities where the whole is connected, S0 at every standpoint with standpoint neutrality where lives are held, and on level paths the axiom is G0 for anything), the dynamics leaving it undecided; where Part II asserts the axiom it is a theorem; Ren then folded positive relevance into significance and left the comparison of courses to the AI, which compares courses on possibilities (P54). The generative space (section 6.13, P56): with no axiom, one level path widens another when it includes and exceeds it, two keep the same when each includes the other, and two are mixed when each exceeds the other; widening goes one way and is transitive, and the four cases exclude one another; the exact boundary of widening is the margin of the part's net draw, with balance only at the conditions each formation requires, across the steps before it; on level paths, with “better” read as widening, C holds for every reading of living and is a law; the comparison over the whole is the comparison within every region at once; with the axiom as a condition, widening is retaining and adding; Ren set the order: enclose the work with no axiom, then take up the one-axiom case; the warrant for calling the generative space good is open; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren. The theory stated in full gathers these as one whole, marking each item as representation, law, theorem, axiom, reading or open; the laws hold of worlds as the spine represents them (discrete steps, natural-number amounts and a shared index; decidedness is not a commitment of the representation but the own condition of the laws that count or name a step, P58), and whether every becoming can be so represented is open philosophical warrant; natural-number amounts make dissipation lose at least a unit at every exchange, and the rest and openness laws rely on that quantum: where the unit may refine, the refinement is itself a change, counted as a formation that gives without taking, which the spine's dissipation excludes, so with the refinement counted the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added, arising without end needs openness, and the witnesses that leave it uncounted are fed by it (R4); the laws without counting it are kept as research notes: where every closed family loses a fixed proportion of what is taken from it, the whole amount an enclosed family exchanges is at most a multiple of its standing, no smaller multiple holding, and, change counted at a size of 1/p of the unit, enclosed exchange, growth, falling, arising and ceasing do not recur at any resolution, and a reserve defers the end only with a least fall per active step, while without a least size change can continue at shrinking sizes, without the proportion change of a whole unit can continue with shrinking losses, and a least loss at each size gives the exchange law but neither the growth law nor the amount law, since a whole unit can pass in ever more, ever smaller transfers (R1 to R3). The theory has two parts. Part I uses no axiom: one unfolding; organization, renewal and evolution; knowing and inquiry; collective dynamics; how evaluation forms; the Universal Metaethical Core (on a connected whole G0 is equivalent to seed ∧ N_rel ∧ N_std, and each normative rival is the same rule within a formed boundary; it holds for any significance, with the axiom only as a condition, moved from Part II by Ren on 11 October 2026, P54); it closes with Part I stated whole, on what holds of every unfolding, what each premise adds, where the dynamics stop deciding and how evaluation holds for any significance. Part II asserts only one axiom (Ren's proposed axiom; G0 is its theorem and, since Ren folded G0, no longer an axiom), stating what the assertion settles and what it does not; and AI alignment. The open programme follows. R5 uses the same flow to state exchange history and the conditions for holding a record: the history count is monotone and, under balance, level changes increase it; lossless exchanges can recur, and dissipation is equivalent to recording each exchange within the conserved amount, a decomposition rather than a derivation from less. Arrows, merging and forgetting on finite families keep their hypotheses, with instances of R6. A bounded record fixes the registered course: histories with at most N and N′ states agreeing before N + N′ − 1 agree everywhere, with no shorter record sufficient for N = 1 and N = N′; the learner that knows the bound is right from 2N − 1 on, and the lasso learner that does not know it from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on; finite registered futures name the split that makes sense without a quotient (P83; the bound is supplied, learners need decidable values, and the readings are the AI's, pending Ren). New formal results are stated on the pure core (L0–L4) of the Lean package Becoming; existing modules connect to it through the bridge, and Mathlib leaves through a peripheral bridge. P70–P72 state what a description loses within one unfolding: separation preserves the whole exactly where it is rectangular; under a determined law a description makes sense by identifying configurations with the same registered future, and finitely many states is a lasso; diagonal gaps concern registration within what it registers, and contextual gluing states when context-free claims fit. An integer-matrix realization of the Mermin–Peres square supplies the quantum instance (P72q). Since 13 October the chapter names modules and sections instead of work-item numbers, and states general laws, with no premise, for every process, of which the earlier machines are instances: stock (balance at each step is balance along every course; a course drawing only on what is held is executable exactly where each draw is within the standing stock; unending repetition needs the return to cover the draw); gated change (a quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it); viability, countdown and lasting (no course leaves a guard exactly where some certificate holds the start; counted work finishes in work + 1 steps exactly when the fuel covers it; a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n, and reaches a target within n steps exactly when some funnel does); loss matching (within one content class a strict loss match exists exactly when the better configuration loses fewer listed claims); copying from a shared pool; grouping by adjacency; reading through a reduction; reading earlier relations from dated records; cross-situational resolution; laws completed up to likeness (on frames with finitely many configurations whose steps and claims are decided, configurations are alike exactly when they pass the same branching tests, proved constructively); and what a learner can learn through its registration. The older machine, market and copying results are restated as instances of these laws. Linear tests see the frame with every branching postponed until it shows: configurations pass the same linear tests exactly when they are alike once branching is postponed, and a frame is alike to its postponement exactly where it is determined up to likeness. With excluded middle as a hypothesis, branching tests fix likeness wherever each move's outcomes are listed, so the periphery's same_iff_bisimilar is a core theorem with that hypothesis. After the seventeenth independent review the chapter's §9 rows state the direction of the common-support law (a configuration losing it is strictly better by matching than none), the bracket law's two conditions (two values, ends that read the same), and structural names in place of market words. Integration I3a states on the spine twenty records whose main proof lay outside the spine run, through two core modules, Becoming.Composition (a whole and its parts are configurations of one unfolding, with one relation added) and Becoming.Joining (joined fragments read as frames through partners, roles and retained references), and five general laws with no premise: a comparison satisfying C needs its description to separate every extension, and a natural-number score satisfying C rises without bound along an endless chain of extensions; every weighting keeps an event's mass from falling exactly where the event is included; fallible witnesses tell two answers apart exactly where their fault sets leave a common faithful witness; a reduction carries the futures exactly where it merges only configurations with the same futures; and what can be had from a configuration is kept exactly where it can be had again. The relation-first re-founding of 14 October (Ren: “why do we need "World"?”, then “please, finish all”) states laws on the levels alone, each with one state of the part written into it: a family whose stock stays within a bound returns, one new at every step exceeds every bound, a bounded family exchanged with without end and a finite whole do not carry their history, and with loss at each change, change does not recur without end; Entropy's forms under the first law are their cases. It reads World's premises off the exchange: activity is exchanging and drawing is taking, and the rest of the whole is counted as a relatum (adopted by Ren), so every world balances and its balance is the rest never active; under a law of exchange, with requirement read as response, activity needs support, so all four tying premises hold by reading, and requirement is a counterfactual of the law that no course fixes. The independence of the eight premises measures the freedom of World's separately chosen fields, not contingency in becoming. One shape states unity: the readings in context of a run always make one world, quantum registrations included; a context-free description exists exactly where they glue; balance is the gluing of the standing's and the exchange's readings of change; with the rest counted every world is one run of the law of exchange; and under the same standard of invariance significance holds within some boundary only by holding for everything (restating Becoming.Boundaries). P83b and P83c make the bounded record exact: two histories with at most N and N′ states are fixed by their record before N + N′ − 1, exactly, for every pair of bounds; within one world a decreasing family of decided equivalences on N configurations stops refining within its classes (Becoming.Refinement), so the same future is agreement for N − 1 values (Moore's bound, exact), and branching frames are alike once alike to depth N − 1 counted by classes. Integration I3b joins nine more records: laws in context (pooling a family of laws runs exactly the courses some single context runs where those courses compose; forgetting a changing context is exact where every context can follow each forgotten step), bounds on realizing a bundle together, and Becoming.Granularity, one unfolding read at a coarser grain, where every test of blocks is a finer test and reading every recipe as one test is exactly excluded middle. Becoming.Keeping states keeping a guard for n steps through what is registered: a plan that keeps makes the class kept, with no premise; with the registrations listed every kept class has a plan, and for arbitrary registrations that converse is exactly choice. P83d removes the decision from Moore's bound: deciding positions rather than values, the same future within one world is agreement for N − 1 steps, with no premise. Integration I3c connects the shared stock, continuation plans and learned-procedure transmission to the core laws through three periphery instance modules, each checked by its own checker. P109 states where a move is formed (Becoming.Coupling), with no premise beyond what each law names: in a part and the rest coupled by one move formed within the whole, the move is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part and the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest, and a move formed by their relation is formed by neither alone; the record of one course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied, and where nothing recurs every reading fits. P83e shows that the tests are a bounded record (Becoming.Distinguishing), with no premise: under a determined law read through a registration, in a world a list of N configurations holds, two configurations pass the same tests exactly where their registered futures agree for N − 1 steps, across two worlds for N + N′ − 1, and the depth N + N′ − 1 between two branching frames is exact for every pair. P83f shows that the rest step needs no bound: the learner reading the record by the least bound, given none, is right at every step from 2N − 1 on, that step is optimal for every learner, and the bound buys only silence. Integration I3d states the last six records outside the run on the spine, adding to four existing core modules a law with no premise each: a judge reading only the reduced value exists for a listed family exactly where the observable agrees on what the reduction merges, answering by the first listed member without choice; readings through parts agree under every reading exactly where the parts agree; a level drawn on and not replenished falls along every course and ends at zero within finitely many steps; a closure is certified by a finite check; a pool is emptied exactly where each token is used as often as it is held. A protection-first comparison is BetterAt on the frame of its options (an exact instance in the bridge), G0 neither used nor asserted; four periphery instance modules are each checked by their own checker. Integration I3e states undominated members of a listed menu in Becoming.Decidedness: where the comparison is irreflexive, transitive and weakly decided on it, a nonempty listed menu has a member no member betters, found in one pass along the list with neither choice nor excluded middle; asked of every relation, existence is exactly weak excluded middle, and dropping the property's decidedness is exactly excluded middle. So the formation requirement of organization and the frontier of protection-first comparison are stated on the spine with no classical reasoning. P83g shows that the refutation learner's rest step is cubic: on an odd cycle of N = 2m + 3 places it is refuted only at step (N³ − N)/4; N − 1 is exact for the tests within one world. P113 answers the least registration with any number of conditions (Becoming.Sensitivity): where a law reads finitely many conditions at each step under each history, it reads what has stood through what it is sensitive to, so sensitivity is the least registration it reads through, however many conditions there are; given a decision of whether levels vanish eventually, the tail law has no least registration; with the conditions numbered every counterexample gives the weak limited principle of omniscience and the decision of vanishing gives the limited one, so no such law can be exhibited in the core. P114 reads the apart modules on the shared base (Becoming.Courses, Becoming.CoursesBridge), with no premise: a disturbed history is a run of the disturbed process, a determined law's orbit is the course of its process, a dated history is a run, and a reduction of a run is a run of the law read through it; the records resting only on apart theorems go from 26 to 0. P116 states identification where runs part and typicality by counting (Becoming.Parting, Becoming.Typicality), with no premise: where two runs register the same before a step and differ at it, no learner is right on both; where no two runs from a configuration part, a run held by N configurations has a course with at most N states and the learner by the least bound is right from 2N − 1 on; under free branching every course is a run’s course, so no record shows that a world will not part; the weighted squared deviations of the courses of n steps add up exactly to n·p·q·(p + q)ⁿ, so most courses show the weights, while that the course which happens is typical is not derived. P115 answers how much difference arrives (Becoming.Propagation), with no premise: in two balanced flows a condition’s gap changes across a step by exactly the difference given less the difference taken; the strength with which an exchange is coupled to a level measures sensitivity, strength zero being insensitivity, and strengths add up over levels changed one at a time; where the rest follows a law with those strengths, every gap is at most the carried amount, which is attained, so it is the most difference that can arrive, and is positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths. Integration I4b item 1 states the one-directional gate laws in Becoming.Gated, with no premise: where the ungated moves reflect a property, a course ending where it holds started where it held or passes a gated step after which it holds (every origin passes the gate), with no decision of the property; with the gate a proposition, asked of every process, the law is exactly double-negation elimination; the origin of LivingOrganization’s pools is its peripheral instance. P117 states that weights count situations (Becoming.Situations), with no premise: where each step is taken in as many situations as its natural weight and each situation fixes its step, the law with the situation as the move is determined, a course weighs the number of situations taking it, and the law of large numbers counts situations; after Ren’s clarification of 16 October 2026 (“the situation makes it true”, readings Ren took), the core states what every situation obeys, the situation makes the actual change true, and a chance is a number of situations of a kind. Integration I4b item 3 states in Becoming.Horizon what a finite history refutes, with no premise: a refutable reading holds, up to double negation, where a run adheres to it; recurrence and eventual occurrence are not refutable and never occurring is not verifiable; the reading of prefix tests is refutable for every process exactly under Markov’s principle; PrefixSafety is its peripheral instance. Integration I4b item 4 states in Becoming.Lasting lifting where branching is finite: in a finitely branching process, arbitrarily long finite courses give some successor arbitrarily long courses up to double negation, with no premise; given EitherThroughout and a selection, a run continues (König lifting); asked of every finitely branching process, an unbounded successor is exactly EitherThroughout; without finite branching there is no lifting; FiniteBranching is its peripheral instance. P110 decides the readings and names formerly left to Ren on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026 (DELEGATED-CHOICES D1–D39, any of which Ren can reverse); what stays Ren's is Ren's own texts and terms, whether Ren holds the step of invariance, the representation decisions Ren reserved, and identification. P111 states in Becoming.Gain where novelty's gain comes from, with no premise: with the rest of the whole counted, every rise of a family's stock across a step is given by some relatum, a formation taking part or the rest; under the first law it comes from the rest or crosses the family's boundary; a finite whole whose rest gives nothing net returns and forgets and is not new at every step. P112 states in Becoming.Gluing when readings in context glue, for parity constraints, with no premise beyond the listed claims and contexts: a contradiction is a selection of contexts counting every claim an even number of times while the parities it requires add up to odd; with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition it is the only obstruction; a context-free assignment meets at most m − 1 of a contradiction's m contexts (a Bell-type bound), with Specker's three boxes, CHSH and the Mermin–Peres square as instances; a cycle of relations is met by a context-free assignment exactly where it holds an even number of differ relations. P119 completes the open proofs of parting and counting (Ren, 16 October 2026: “take 2, and do the open proofs”), with no premise: with registered values decided, where runs part only before step T, the learner reading the record with the least bound is right at every step from 2(T + N) − 1; for listed, decided processes, the learner given the world is right at a step on every run exactly where no two runs part there; over finitely many configurations a course of N steps gives its start courses of every length, with no decidability and no selection (Lasting.Unbounded); the counting Chernoff bound gives exponential concentration; any number of values is counted through an event; situations are counted per course for every process; signed weights are pairs of counts of situations, composing to adding and to subtracting, and where signed weights cancel the situations do not. Integration I4b item 2 states in Becoming.Selection selection by the record alone, with no premise (the options' decided equality named in each statement): a selection reads the record alone when exchanging two options' entries exchanges what it selects; two options are selected alike by every such selection exactly when the record ties them; a selection of at most one option can single out k exactly when no other option's entry ties k's; PluralRecords and TieBreaking are its peripheral instance (SelectionRelabelCorrespondence). P118 states in Becoming.Loops how a carried difference grows, with no premise beyond the strengths each theorem names: order j is what routes of at most j responses carry, the orders rising to the carried amount; where no loop lies upstream the order one less than the number of conditions is exact at every step and the carried amount is at most a polynomial; a fed loop upstream leaves every order inexact, what returns around it multiplied by at least one plus the product of the strengths; a cut at order j misses at most an exact bound, which a self-loop attains; with the same formations and strengths at every step, a finite order is exact from every start and growth is at most polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream. On Ren's word of 16 October 2026, I4b item 2 is reframed as selection through a model of the options: the entries the law reads are the selector's model of the options, what it can tell apart; what a model lumps, no selection through it can separate; separating them takes a finer model, and whether that model is right is its fit to what matters (8 theorems in Becoming.Learning link a model to its lumping), which is wisdom, not memory; the arrival-order reading is withdrawn. P120 states in Becoming.Remainder what a cut loses, for every schedule of couplings, with no premise: a cut at order j loses exactly what j + 1 responses carry, where a longer chain in time order arrives; once the schedule settles, a finite order is exact exactly where no loop of continuing couplings lies upstream, the only way past every polynomial. P121 joins P82's sum over histories with P118's orders in Becoming.Routes: the carried amount is a sum over routes back in time, the sum over histories at horizon j + 1 being order j of the carried amount, so a cut is a truncation; every sum over histories expands by order, exact up to its horizon; with stationary strengths a finite horizon is exact exactly where no loop lies upstream. P122 states in Becoming.Closing how loops form within the unfolding: a loop forms by closing, the loops formed by T + 1 being those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at T that closes a chain; before it forms growth is polynomial and does not show that it will; with strengths read off the course, formation is read off the unfolding. P124 joins loop formation with Becoming.Runaway's policies in Becoming.Thresholds, with no premise beyond what each law names: an unread level is coupled with strength zero, so loops lie within what a law reads and none passes through a level nothing reads; for every law reading a stock only below a threshold (Runaway's formation, depending on a stock it does not observe, is an instance), a raise of the stock is carried nowhere up to the break, and before the break the law is its standing law with no loop through the stock, so the loop through the stock forms at the break. P123 states in Becoming.Frequency how often couplings act: counting only the steps at which couplings act, the carried amount is at most D·(1 + M)^a for a such steps, so runaway needs frequent couplings, not strong ones, and returns around a loop at least double what has arrived; a loop that recurs ever more rarely makes every finite order inexact yet stays polynomial; settling is local, each coupling recurring or stopping, and that every schedule settles is exactly the limited principle of omniscience (LPO). P125 states in Becoming.Observation how a formation comes to observe what it depends on: a difference goes only downstream, along routes of reading from where it starts, so for every law reading into each condition a schedule, courses apart only in a stock are alike at every condition not downstream of it by the readings formed so far; observing the stock itself is the route of length zero, a measurement a longer one, and a route forms by closing, as loops do. P126 states in Becoming.Tail what a law of the whole and no part takes: with the conditions numbered, a number changed by no condition that still differs, and so a counterexample to the least registration, exists exactly where a rule decides, of every unending record of yes and no, whether it says no throughout (the weak limited principle of omniscience, WLPO, as a rule); the decision of vanishing, which the tail law takes, is exactly the limited principle (LPO) as a rule. P127 states in Becoming.Onward where a run goes on, with nothing selected: within finitely many configurations a run starts exactly where a course leads to a return, so whatever goes on without end does so by coming round, and the laws along runs hold for every configuration from which the process can keep moving; where moves can be searched a run is built as data; asked of every process, that every configuration that can keep moving starts a run is exactly dependent choice.

**Significance:** It organizes the scattered chapters into one theory with a single entry point; earlier chapters remain the records of their arguments and evidence at original scope, while this chapter takes over their role as entry points. Work-item numbers in this reading refer to the study and its work board; the chapter's glossary maps them to modules and sections.

**Scope:** Organization and exposition by AI (Claude), with Ren’s words quoted. Every declaration of the spine has an empty axiom report; the core imports nothing outside itself and compiles from Lean’s prelude alone; premises are definitions or hypotheses in Lean, not axioms. No ethical axiom does not mean no substantive premise, and an empty axiom report does not mean no premises. The chapter adds no proof and cites checked results only.

**Next:** The first open question is the deductive necessity of the whole: passing from a determinate whole account to the claim that its differentiations are internally related moments of one unfolding; also open is the universal practical warrant. The whole-run, stepwise (active and not undermining, the working candidate), cycle and relation-level readings of living are defined and compared on the core and reviewed independently four times; 生生 is read as the generative space, the widening of what can form, and G0 and C share this reading (D1, D22). One correspondence discipline for conditions (interaction) is stated; its time order, its sensitivity to effect and its statement for the whole-run reading, a run-independent reading, a web of dependence with amounts and renewal rates, and a component of further generation remain open. Open items are sorted into four classes: Ren's choices, philosophical warrant, empirical correspondence and further proofs; the scope of representation is listed as philosophical warrant. On Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026 the readings and names formerly left to Ren are decided by the AI, and Ren can reverse any of them (DELEGATED-CHOICES D1–D39): among them the readings of the one axiom (P39), route (b) (P40), feedback and reach (P42), the axiom decomposed (P43) and the generative space (P56), and the re-founding's readings (curvature only as an analogy of method; novelty as gain from beyond the part, now proved in Becoming.Gain; the axiom coming to the presupposition, adopted with exact scope, the step of invariance not derived). What stays Ren's: Ren's own texts and terms, whether Ren holds the step of invariance, the representation decisions Ren reserved, the decisions of review two records leave to Ren, and identification, which Ren's words of 15 and 16 October settle. Of the readings posed after the delegation, Ren took I4b's three (every origin passing the gate, what a finite history refutes, lifting where branching is finite) on 16 October 2026 (“agree with other readings”); of P118's three, Ren took the first two, and the third (which loops a world has is part of its situation) in its refined form, pending a theorem on how loops form, which P122 gives (Becoming.Closing); on 16 October 2026 Ren took the third reading as revised by that theorem (loops form within the unfolding by closing and dissolve where their couplings stop), together with the readings of P121 (Becoming.Routes) and P122 (“alright, agree”); selection by the record alone is reframed, on Ren's word, as selection through a model of the options. Ren took P124's readings on 16 October 2026 (“agree in general”): a runaway's break is where a loop forms, and what registers the distance is a reading of the stock before the break; how a formation comes to observe a stock is answered by P125 (Becoming.Observation: observing is being downstream along a route of readings), whose readings are the AI's, pending Ren. P123's readings are the AI's, pending Ren; how fast a runaway of given strengths is (a spectral radius) stays open. P126's readings are the AI's, pending Ren; whether the proposition WLPO alone gives the rule (a step of unique choice) stays open. P127's readings are the AI's, pending Ren; runs along unbounded configurations with finite branching and nothing searched still go through a selection.

<a id="the-theory-of-evolution"></a>
<a id="演化之论--the-theory-of-evolution"></a>
## The Theory of Evolution

**ID:** `the-theory-of-evolution` · **Category:** research programme

**Source:** [THE-THEORY-OF-EVOLUTION.md](../chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-EVOLUTION.md)

**Status:** Several focused connections checked; six broader requirements open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `ef6b557f1fa9…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** An evolutionary explanation must say what is reconstructed, what changes, how descendants arise and how their consequences affect later continuation; selection is only part of it, and variation, stochastic sampling, movement, changed transmission and developmental reconstruction cannot all be relabeled selection. A living organization, its supporting relations and its effects differentiate within one unfolding, without independent organism and environment substances. Completed focused connections include recursive generative selection from actual output through reconstruction to successor operation; formation and change of evolutionary organization; one-step connectionist recovery with a recurrent extension; recall, loss and restoration in one nonlinear developmental-memory network; consequences feeding updater replacement; acquired discrimination controlling updating; reference renewal through change; reliable updating under bounded change; and material preparation, growth to fragmentation, structural copying, formed copying relations and correction of an existing successor; and, on the Becoming core, Price's equation in counting form with selection through support (transmission supplied). After Ren’s systems/subsystems correction, the current focus is differentiation, feedback and boundary change within one system, and how such differences are reformed after succession or division.

**Significance:** It sets up the evolutionary theory as a programme with six completion requirements and prevents a locally completed row from passing for completion of the whole theory.

**Scope:** Connections carry their own counts (for example structural copying 34 theorems / 57 audits; reference renewal 34/50; updater replacement 36/57). A direct comparison with a conventional network implementation using the same information and laws yields exact equivalence of finite histories, failures and readouts (11 theorems / 24 audits, 34,768 comparisons), with no distinct prediction or reduction of supplied mechanisms. The earlier empirical programme is retained but is not a completion gate for the present theoretical work.

**Next:** Explain how joint activity changes the task, testing relations and means of participation themselves, and how work/capability feedback closes organizational dynamics; a comparative contribution requires independently constrained joint measurements.

<a id="关系生成与智慧的条件--relational-generativity-and-the-conditions-of-wisdom"></a>
## Relational generativity and the conditions of wisdom

**ID:** `theory` · **Category:** synthesis

**Source:** [THEORY.md](../history/THEORY.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Conditional foundation

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `ebfee063cf01…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Activity changes conditions of further activity; continuing effects differentiate into organization, learning and response. Renewal, usable evidence, reason revision, protection and successor reconstruction compose under explicit conditions, with failures explained too. Wisdom concerns warranted changes to action and conditions of later correction.

**Significance:** Gives separate constructions a common explanatory progression and an accepted conditional foundation.

**Scope:** Current research updates this synthesis’s historical frontier. Underlying Lean results prove specific interfaces, not the entire philosophy, universal ethics or empirical inevitability.

**Next:** Current priority: whether The Theory of Becoming can be grounded without added substantive axioms (canonical entry THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING); the connected articulation continues in SHENGSHENG. Proposed: add mechanisms/evidence only where they advance named unresolved inferences.

<a id="theory-of-becoming"></a>
<a id="生成关系怎样变化--how-relations-of-becoming-change"></a>
## How relations of becoming change

**ID:** `theory-of-becoming` · **Category:** mechanism

**Source:** [THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md](../chapters/THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md)

**Status:** Checked conditional results; whole grounding open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `71c0d3c735dc…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Starting from actual relations, the chapter follows how activity establishes, exercises and changes participating relations and how those changes sustain, transform or end the conditions of later activity. Formation, maintenance, transformation, degeneration and dissolution are overlapping explanatory questions, not a fixed sequence; a retained form need not keep its former efficacy. Checked connections: in a two-qubit case the local reduced states stay unchanged while joint efficacy changes, and keeping one joint cross term follows every finite word of the declared operations exactly; current capacity differs from eventual reachability, with a preparation-step bound; under a fixed law all existential endpoint possibilities are preserved iff some path returns to the original configuration; renewing and consuming formation are separated by the continuation conditions of the relations they participate in, exclusive but not exhaustive, and a formation not depending on what it consumes can persist without bound while ending the dependent relation; under the relational reading C ranks every overdraw strictly below the continuation without it; and after interruption a supported repair route can restore the sustaining condition within a finite window.

**Significance:** It gives the checkable relational content of what G0 already affirms, 生生, rather than restricting G0, and brings degeneration into the same relational description without presupposing good or bad.

**Scope:** Relational classification 35 theorems / 60 audits; comparison 15; return 10/14; repair 9/10; joint cross term 11/25; empty axiom reports. The law family has one shared condition, no substitution and strict per-step renewal; no real-world correspondence or ethical ranking is established, and C does not decide mixed cases. Universal necessity of the whole and the zero-added-substantive-axiom hypothesis are not proved.

**Next:** Which common constitutive claim these completed connections support, and why it is indispensable at the required scope, with real losses retained. The canonical entry and Becoming spine now unify this chapter.

## Unified ethical grounding within becoming

**ID:** `unified-ethical-grounding` · **Category:** normative foundation

**Source:** [UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md](../history/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Explicit G0 route: practical judgment complete; renewed zero-axiom inquiry open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `18b975d10ade…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Life and further generation within the whole provide the explicit common normative starting point across ecological, lived and broad organizational scopes. Actual generative extension preserving relevant grounds can support maintenance, reorganization or endings under stated comparison and practical premises. K offers defeasible favor for interruption that restores shared living; loss remains part of the same ground. Warranted mixed judgments can transport across matched loss reductions. K alone supplies no all-things-considered priority, and forming future conditions does not automatically defeat finite fulfillment. Under Ren’s 8 October correction, this alignment task takes G0 as an explicit axiom, with J1–J4 as disclosed additions. Within visible continuations, a response can have positive generative significance without fixing the form of its future good.

**Significance:** Connects a common generative direction to situated practice while distinguishing extension of warranted comparisons, first ethical grounding and sacrifice limits.

**Scope:** Explicit-premise inference 11 theorems/27 audits, joint realization five, necessary loss 11/28, comparison transport 16/23 and living dependency 10+15 keep their scopes. The G0 route adds practical judgment (30 theorems/46 audits), positive generative warrant (9/30) and relational generative judgment (6/12); J1–J4 do not follow from G0 alone. Zero-axiom practical judgment is reopened in its own chapter; neither ethical warrant nor universal impossibility is proved.

**Next:** Ongoing: zero-axiom practical warrant—whether actual living quality bears practically on a responsive position without presupposed normative commitments. On the G0 route, threshold correspondence, implementation and ethical classification of newly formed kinds are separate tasks; an arbitrary increase in joint possibility does not show the whole is better.

<a id="wisdom-and-context"></a>
<a id="智慧情境与共同核心--wisdom-context-and-the-common-core"></a>
## Wisdom, context and the common core

**ID:** `wisdom-and-context` · **Category:** philosophical epistemic

**Source:** [WISDOM-AND-CONTEXT.md](../chapters/WISDOM-AND-CONTEXT.md)

**Status:** Conditional checks and philosophical application; root-of-wisdom target open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `8de72d7281b3…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Ren’s target is to show that the core is the root of wisdom: to establish the core’s substantive constitutive necessity for wisdom and a generative account of understanding, concern, response and self-correction. First round: one unchanged requirement can call for opposite responses, and an earlier response’s success can create the conditions for reversal; a candidate common structure of wisdom is judging the present response through actually formed relations while including how the response changes later conditions of judgment. Later sections show that different descriptions sufficient for action need not share a coarsest still-sufficient description, so a common practical ground need not be a shared least description; equal attainment of old and new ends can still carry opposite protection comparisons; a correct risk statement can coexist with actual failure, and one outcome does not decide the original bound; a common root must explain differentiated standards and their connections; morality judges becoming through established universal generative principles; and common G0/J grounds yield a family of eight scoped situated judgments with reversal conditions and principled room for choice. Following Ren's 13 October word that these form one theory, sections 16–31 connect the target to completed results on the shared spine: judgment content to formation, acquisition, revision and use; tacit understanding, letting-go and transformation; theoretical wisdom and chance discovery through operative content relations rather than reliable origins; claim-level fidelity and selection preservation through pure-core adapters; fallible and timely discrimination; realized relevance without a productive-payoff premise; the common operational factor of exact joining accounts; law-grounded alternatives, with static descriptions retaining these relations standing equally; and fallible acceptance of operative grounds.

**Significance:** It moves the wisdom question from overlap with classical texts to testable structural requirements, and shows that different responses or not explicitly following principles do not alone refute a common normative ground.

**Scope:** First round 11 theorems; response structure 9; goal grounds 7; fallible judgment 5 new applications. The rest is philosophical application and classical comparison, supporting scoped structural overlap while keeping substantive ethical differences. It does not prove that all historical wisdom follows uniquely from the core; local match, constraint compliance and valid inference transfer cannot alone complete the target. Sections 16–31 are philosophical integration and author counterreview reusing completed results, with pure-core adapters for claim fidelity and regrouping (empty axiom reports) and no new empirical work; full necessity remains open.

**Next:** The check of judgment content against completed formation, feedback-acquisition and revision results is done (sections 16–31). Next justify the common dependencies across the intended wisdom scope, allowing differing realizations and omission of irrelevant distinctions; the root-of-wisdom target keeps both constitutive necessity and actual formation.

<a id="zero-axiom-practical-judgment"></a>
<a id="零公理实践判断正在建立的根据--zero-axiom-practical-judgment"></a>
## Zero-axiom practical judgment

**ID:** `zero-axiom-practical-judgment` · **Category:** normative foundation

**Source:** [ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md](../chapters/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md)

**Status:** Zero-axiom warrant unestablished; instrumental results checked

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `55f98d1cc4c5…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Reopened at Ren’s direct request, the zero-axiom target is to explain why actual relations themselves carry practical force and to give comparison, preservation, transformation, transfer, ending and responsibility, without placing normative premises inside definitions of adequacy, constitution or legitimacy. The affirmative route treats judging as activity that forms action; a step-by-step check shows that occurrence, coherent content, ownership of a judgment, shared formation and correction each support part of the account but do not settle whether a task ought to be done or which responsibility holds. J2 test: for any finite sample a finite positive weight agrees with lexical priority on every sampled comparison yet reverses on an unobserved one. Later sections take up Ren’s direction that normative structure lies within generation and degeneration of cognition and information; construct normative differentiation within whole activity, where adaptive closure still cannot supply a missing distinction; show how grounds of understanding standards constrain assessment; and require universal practical authority to keep differences. §17 audits directly: a universal reason need not lie beyond all appropriate deliberation; what matters is that its validity cannot be certified merely by the formation of endorsement or motivation. Sections 18–23 propose and counterreview a nonexclusive response ground: a response's point lies in what it actually sustains, opens or repairs, and actual living improvement can support forming concern before concern exists. Following Ren's 13 October correction, warranted practical articulation is treated as constituted within activity that differentiates living, understanding, purposes and response, keeping distinct omission in a representation, suppression of feedback and informed maintenance of harm; restrictions are tested by whether they still supply needed support; and the fulfillment test is narrowed to a local diagnostic of how actual living relations enter the grounds of maintaining, changing or ending activity.

**Significance:** It keeps the zero-axiom target at full strength rather than passing off ‘no ethical axiom’ or an empty axiom report as success, and locates the remaining first normative warrant precisely.

**Scope:** 24 checked theorems / 35 declaration audits keep their instrumental scope; no new ethical proof is claimed. The earlier ‘blocked’ audit is retained historically. The G0/J1–J4 route remains a completed result under disclosed premises and is not renamed a zero-axiom result; no impossibility is claimed. Sections 18–23 are AI philosophical argument and counterreview with no new mathematics or independent verification.

**Next:** The unresolved identification is that actual living quality has practical significance for an eligible responder without antecedent concern being its exclusive source; the strongest affirmative argument has not established its universal scope without supplied normative commitments. The next inquiry adjudicates recognition of a prior ground against concern that allegedly constitutes all practical address, within one fully specified purpose revision.
